title: PokerStars freerolls: the .fr Stars program
description: Free qualifiers feed two weekly finals on PokerStars.fr. Check the ticket requirement and regional account before treating this as an open-entry final.

market.label: France · PokerStars.fr
market.note: This source describes PokerStars.fr only. It does not confirm the same promotion in the US, UK or another PokerStars market. Account and location eligibility must be checked with PokerStars.

requirements: An eligible real-money PokerStars.fr account; the official page says no deposit is required.
Finish in the top 27 of a free Satellite Stars Freeroll to obtain a finals ticket.
Tickets expire after 31 days.
entry.costNote: Free qualifier entry; weekly finals require a qualification ticket. This is not a deposit-bonus offer.

reward.label: €1,500 cash / T€500
reward.details: The Sunday final advertises €1,500 cash; Wednesday advertises T€500 in tournament money. These are separate pools, not a payout to every entrant.

schedule.text: Daily qualifier at 20:00; Wednesday final at 20:00 and Sunday final at 16:00. The official page labels final times CET. Check the lobby for daylight-saving handling and the next dated occurrence.

sections.title: What the listing covers
sections.text: This is a recurring program, not a confirmed seat in today’s tournament. The qualifier and final have different entry conditions.

sections.title: Finding other PokerStars freerolls
sections.text: PokerStars’ help page explains that freerolls are listed in the tournament lobby, sometimes with ticket or password requirements. Availability differs by market; an empty lobby filter means none are available at that time.

title: PartyPoker Round-the-Clock Freerolls
description: An hourly program with Party Dollars or tournament-ticket prizes. The entry fee is zero, but account and deposit conditions still matter.

market.label: UK / eligible PartyPoker markets
market.note: The source is the international PartyPoker offer, with UK promotion reference UKREQ0008466. Restricted countries are excluded. This is not a US offer; confirm availability for your specific account and location.

requirements: Verified eligible real-money account, poker client, and access to promotions.
18+; the offer specifies 19+ in Canada, whose local availability is not confirmed here.
PartyPoker’s general freeroll guide says real-money players must have made at least one deposit.
entry.costNote: Do not treat zero tournament entry as no-deposit eligibility. A funded-account condition is described in the official general guide.

reward.label: P$ or tournament tickets
reward.details: Current offer advertises $20–$50 pools and $500 total per day across tournaments. Party Dollars cannot be exchanged for cash; they expire after 12 months.

schedule.text: The offer describes starts on the hour, daily until further notice. Exact dated tournaments and pool details are in the lobby. Single entry; the promotion terms describe 60 minutes of late entry.

sections.title: Reading the prizes
sections.text: The daily promotional total is spread across tournaments. P$ is playing credit, not a withdrawable cash prize.

sections.title: Before choosing a tournament
sections.text: The current promotion and the general eligibility guide are both linked below. Check the client for your available event and any account-specific restriction.

title: 888poker 24/7 Freerolls Festival
description: Freebie and Fabulous freerolls have different entry routes. Both sit within a promotion for funded players, with additional regional restrictions.

market.label: Great Britain · eligible accounts
market.note: UK terms are published, but Northern Ireland is explicitly excluded. Other markets have their own eligibility rules; no US availability is confirmed by these sources.

requirements: Eligible registered and funded account; age 18 or the higher local minimum.
The terms distinguish earlier funded accounts with qualifying real-money activity from first deposits after the promotion began.
Freebie entry needs no ticket; Fabulous requires a Multiprize Wheel ticket.
entry.costNote: Funded-account promotion. No ticket for a Freebie does not mean no deposit or no eligibility conditions.

reward.label: Prize varies by freeroll
reward.details: The promotional page advertises over $9,000 across the week, not for one tournament. Confirm each event’s payout and reward type in the lobby; wheel rewards and tournament prizes are different.

schedule.text: Ongoing daily promotion. The operator sets individual start times; exact dated starts are not published on the source page.

sections.title: Two different access routes
sections.text: A Freebie and a Fabulous tournament are not interchangeable. Check whether a ticket is required before selecting an event.

sections.title: What to confirm in the lobby
sections.text: Check the individual time, prize type, ticket validity and account eligibility. The official page does not establish that every advertised reward is withdrawable cash.

title: Freeroll Atlanta: free-entry live poker
description: A local No-Limit Hold’em league in Atlanta bars and restaurants. Entry is free, but qualifying for points or gift certificates requires venue spending.

market.label: Atlanta, Georgia · United States
market.note: In-person Atlanta venues only. This is not an online poker offer available across Georgia or the United States. Confirm venue admission and age requirements with the host.

requirements: Attend the listed Atlanta venue and check its admission requirements.
The rules require a $10 venue tab to qualify for points or gift certificates.
Optional food or drink purchases can add chips during early levels.
entry.costNote: Free entry does not mean a cost-free prize opportunity: a $10 tab is required for points/gift certificates, and purchases may provide extra chips.

reward.label: Venue prizes / selected cash nights
reward.details: Nightly prizes vary by venue. The prize page describes venue credit for top finishers. The schedule separately labels selected cash-prize nights; no fixed payout is assumed here.

schedule.text: Selected official dated starts are verified through November 5, 2026. Times are Atlanta local time. The October 2 Neighbor’s Pub listing appears twice, including a qualifiers-only final, so that ambiguous start remains omitted. Check the organizer for venue notices and eligibility.

sections.title: Know the spending conditions
sections.text: The organizer describes free entry. Its separate rules add a spending condition for points and gift certificates, plus purchase-related extra chips.

sections.title: Confirm before travelling
sections.text: Check the official venue link and day’s listing. Late-entry limits conflict between the schedule and rules, so arrive before the published start or contact the organizer.

officialLinks.label: Official dated calendar and venue links

reviewNote: The schedule says late entry lasts 1 hour 40 minutes, while the rules say 1 hour. A registration deadline is not confirmed. The 2 October 19:00 calendar entries overlap and one is marked qualifiers only; eligibility for that start is not confirmed.

title: Riverchasers: free live poker in Pennsylvania & New Jersey
description: Free-entry No-Limit Hold’em at participating bars and restaurants in Pennsylvania and New Jersey. Local league games and the paid, qualification-only championships have different entry conditions.

market.label: Pennsylvania & New Jersey · United States
market.note: In-person venues listed by the official Riverchasers league calendar. This guide does not establish online poker availability or eligibility in other states.

requirements: Ordinary live league games are open to the public, age 21 or older.
A free basic Bar Poker Open membership is required for rankings and rewards; use the organizer’s check-in instructions.
Food and drink purchases are encouraged. Confirm any venue-specific admission or spending conditions.
entry.costNote: Ordinary league participation has no entry charge. Championship finals require qualification and an entry fee. Optional paid online PRO membership is separate.

reward.label: Local prizes / qualification opportunities
reward.details: The organizer advertises local prizes and routes to league championships. Check the venue’s current prize terms; a championship prize is not a guaranteed reward at an ordinary league game.

schedule.text: Selected official league starts are verified for October 1–6, 2026 in Pennsylvania and New Jersey. Times are local to each venue. The separate qualified championship is not an open-entry free league game; use the official calendar for last-minute changes.

sections.text: No. The published Season 40 rules require qualification and an entry fee. Do not confuse those finals with the free public league games.

sections.text: Open the Riverchasers calendar below and confirm the venue, date and check-in arrangements. The organizer also publishes instructions for new players on its website.

title: Free Poker Network: free live poker leagues
description: Find free live poker at participating US bars through Free Poker Network. Check local venues, the 21+ age rule and account requirements before playing for league points and championship invitations.

market.label: Participating US venues
market.note: The official directory lists leagues in Colorado, Delaware, Florida, Illinois, Indiana, Minnesota, Nebraska, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Dakota, South Dakota, Texas and Wisconsin. Availability is venue-specific, not statewide. This guide covers live league play only.

requirements: Players must be 21 or older and register an FPN account.
Verified contact details are required for points and prizes; mailed awards need a valid mailing address.
Hosts retain their own admission policies. Championship invitations must be earned and cannot be transferred.
entry.costNote: FPN describes its social games as free to play and prohibits forced consideration. Confirm individual venue policies and any optional spending before travelling.

reward.label: League points and qualification opportunities
reward.details: Attendance earns points toward standings and championship invitations. Awards depend on the promotion and applicable restrictions; no fixed cash prize is promised for each local game.

schedule.text: A recurring league programme. Find the host and its current event details through the official regional directory. No future dated starts are inferred from weekly play.

sections.title: Where can I play?
sections.text: Choose a region, then inspect its participating venues. The directory includes Midwest leagues, Nevada and several East Coast states. A state in our filter means a listed league exists, not that every city has a game.

sections.title: Is a championship seat automatic?
sections.text: No. Local play is an entry point into the league. Qualification and prizes follow the current promotion; earlier cash awards and travel packages are not guarantees for today’s games.

sections.title: Who supports the league?
sections.text: FPN explains that sponsoring venues support its promotions. Its background page describes local league play and routes toward national finals. Use that explanation alongside the current participation rules.

officialLinks.label: Official age, account and participation rules

title: World Tavern Poker: free live bar poker
description: Find free-entry live poker at participating US bars. Check local age and customer policies, then use the official game finder; league points and championship qualification are separate from a guaranteed cash prize.

market.label: Participating US venues
market.note: The official 2026 regional pages confirm coverage in Maryland, Michigan, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Tennessee and Virginia. This is selected venue coverage, not statewide availability. Use the ZIP-code finder for an actual host; this guide covers live play only.

requirements: Register an organizer account and follow its instructions to sign up for a local tournament.
The league minimum is 18; many venues admit only players aged 21 or older. Championship participants must meet the separate 21-by-national-finals rule.
A venue may apply a general customer or minimum-purchase policy to all patrons. Check with the host before travelling.
entry.costNote: Ordinary bar tournaments have no buy-in. That does not guarantee a visit without spending: venue customer policies may apply. The rules prohibit awarding extra chips for purchases.

reward.label: League points, prizes and qualification
reward.details: Local play earns points toward standings and later championships. Regional rewards can include event access passes or packages. Eligibility and prizes vary; no fixed cash payout is promised for an ordinary bar game.

schedule.text: A recurring live league. The official introduction links to a ZIP-code game finder. No future dated starts are generated here from weekly play, and past regional finals are not advertised as upcoming open games.

sections.title: How do I find a game near me?
sections.text: Open the official league introduction below and follow Find A Game. Search by ZIP code, then confirm the host, start and admission policy before going. The introduction is a guide to the organizer’s finder, not a direct seat reservation.

sections.title: Are championships open to every new player?
sections.text: No. Regional seats require qualification and cannot be transferred. The ordinary local game is the starting point; do not assume that free league entry grants access to a national final.

officialLinks.label: Official live league explanation and game-finder link

title: World Free Poker in New Jersey
description: Free live poker at New Jersey venues in Bayonne, Garfield and Elmwood Park. Ordinary games have no buy-in or drink minimum; monthly rewards require separate qualification, and spending receipts can affect points and awards.

market.label: New Jersey, United States
market.note: Local in-person games only. Check the named venue and its latest notice before travelling.

requirements: Age 21 or older; bring valid ID for prizes.
Register online or with the dealer for ordinary games; unregistered arrivals may have to wait.

Gift-certificate finals require a venue top-10 finish; Winners voucher entry requires a qualifying win, while Pasadena uses the top 25. Check the official qualifying list. Receipts of $10 or more can affect points and awards.
entry.costNote: No entry fee, cover charge or drink minimum for ordinary games. Venue spending is separate and can change points or finals awards.

reward.label: Venue rewards and qualified finals
reward.details: The schedule lists gift-certificate competitions and a Winners betting-voucher final. These are not guaranteed cash payments to every participant.

schedule.text: Selected October finals are listed below for qualified players. Buttero’s Thursday game has moved to Friday. Ordinary weekly games remain on the official calendar; no future dates have been generated from that recurring timetable.

sections.title: Can I join without paying?
sections.text: The FAQ permits free ordinary entry with no drink minimum. The scoring system separately uses qualifying results and spending receipts for some rewards.

sections.title: Where should I check before leaving?
sections.text: Read the venue notices and registration page. Meadowlands play is marked suspended; do not treat its old voucher notices as current games.

sections.title: Are the dated finals open to everyone?
sections.text: No. The listed starts require prior qualification. Gift certificates and betting vouchers are different rewards from cash; ordinary games and their availability should be checked separately.

reviewNote: The current notice and timetable put the Winners voucher final on October 4, but a lower paragraph still headed September gives October 18. We retain the previously confirmed October 4 listing; ask the organizer to confirm before travelling.

title: GGPoker UK Daily and Weekly Freerolls
description: A ticket-based UK freeroll programme. Official help describes a verified-new-account route to Daily Freeroll tickets, alongside deposit and real-money-play routes. Daily qualifiers award Weekly Freeroll tickets; a zero buy-in does not remove eligibility conditions.

market.label: United Kingdom
market.note: For eligible GGPoker UK accounts under the UK site’s age and location rules. This guide does not establish availability in the United States or other markets.

requirements: Age 18 or older and an eligible verified UK account.
New-account tickets are limited to genuinely new GGPoker Network players; existing network accounts do not qualify.
UK players may need to opt in under My Promo. A valid ticket is required.
entry.costNote: A deposit is not part of the verified-new-account ticket route described in official help. Other qualification routes involve deposits or real-money play; they are not cost-free play.

reward.label: Qualification tickets; weekly prize pool
reward.details: Daily paid-place finishers receive Weekly Freeroll tickets, not a cash award from that qualifier. The Weekly help page describes a $100,000 prize pool; confirm the current tournament and payout terms in the lobby.

schedule.text: Help describes Daily qualifiers at 10:00 and 22:00 UTC and a Weekly final on Saturday at 16:00 UTC. These are recurring programme times, not verified dated lobby entries.

sections.title: How does the no-deposit route work?
sections.text: Official help describes three Daily tickets after a genuinely new account completes basic verification. Those tickets expire after seven days; Daily-won Weekly tickets expire after 30 days.

sections.title: What should existing players check?
sections.text: Help also describes qualifying deposits, cash-game achievements and referral conditions. Check the official rules and your own My Promo eligibility before treating any route as available.

officialLinks.label: Official UK age and location rules

title: Redtooth Tavern Online Freeroll — UK Members
description: A zero-buy-in online league on PartyPoker for active Redtooth pub members. Compete for regional-final qualification and online-event tickets; membership, operator eligibility and later final fees still apply.

market.label: United Kingdom — active Redtooth venue members
market.note: For eligible UK pub-league members with access to PartyPoker. This guide does not establish availability in the United States.

requirements: Age 18 or older and registered membership of an active Redtooth venue.
Eligible PartyPoker account; obtain the current password through Redtooth’s official member area.
Confirm operator deposit conditions: the public Redtooth explanation does not establish a no-deposit exemption.
entry.costNote: Online Tavern entry is free. Regional and national finals charge GBP 10 under the published terms; venue games can have their own costs.

reward.label: Regional-final qualification and online tickets
reward.details: The season’s top 15 qualify for their allocated regional final. Venue qualification takes precedence, and seats cannot be transferred. These rewards are not a guaranteed cash payout.

schedule.text: The organizer describes Sunday play at 14:00, with registration from noon, during a 13-week league season. It does not specify a timezone or dated upcoming starts here; check the lobby.

sections.title: Can anyone join this freeroll?
sections.text: No. Active pub-venue membership is required. This guide covers the Tavern league; separately advertised paid qualifiers are not included.

sections.title: Where is the official entry information?
sections.text: Use the public program explanation and rules below. Member passwords remain with the organizer.

title: Maverick Poker League: free live poker in Michigan
description: Free-entry live poker at Michigan venues in Lapeer, Burton, Flint and Metamora. Players earn tokens toward prizes, merchandise and tournament entries; regular league games and qualified championships have different entry conditions.

market.label: Michigan, United States
market.note: In-person league venues only; this is not a statewide online poker offer.

requirements: Age 21 or older.
Register your name, phone number and email once to be eligible for prizes.
A game needs at least six players; prizes require at least eight. Qualified championship events have separate conditions.
entry.costNote: The FAQ states no buy-ins or entry fees. Dealer tips are optional. Venue purchases are separate; outside food and drinks are prohibited.

reward.label: Tokens, prizes and tournament entries
reward.details: Tokens can be redeemed for merchandise, prizes or entries to casino and charity tournaments. This is not a promise of cash winnings at every league game.

schedule.text: Recurring first starts: Mayfield Tavern and Trapper Joe’s on Tuesday at 6 pm; Timothy’s Pub on Wednesday at 6 pm; BJ’s Bar on Thursday at 6 pm; Cascaddan Lounge on Saturday at 3 pm. Later games have approximate starts. Check the official timetable and venue notices before travelling.

sections.title: Where can I play?
sections.text: The official directory lists Mayfield Tavern in Lapeer, BJ’s Bar and Trapper Joe’s in Burton, Timothy’s Pub in Flint, and Cascaddan Lounge in Metamora.

sections.title: Is every championship open to a new player?
sections.text: Regular league entry and qualified finals are separate. Check the organizer’s eligibility rules for the championship you want to attend.

officialLinks.label: Official venues, weekly timetable and league rules

title: Not Quite Vegas: Free Bar Poker in Florida
description: Free-entry live Hold’em around Florida’s Space Coast and Treasure Coast. Venue spending can add chips, and league wins qualify players for a separate championship. Check the local venue’s age policy before visiting.

market.label: Florida — Brevard and Indian River counties
market.note: In-person venues around Melbourne, Rockledge, Sebastian and Vero Beach; this is not a statewide online offer.

requirements: League minimum age is 18; many venues require 21+.
Ordinary games use first-come seating. Championship entry requires recorded league wins.
entry.costNote: Entry is free and dealer tips are optional. Food, drink and other purchases can earn bonus chips; zero buy-in does not mean everyone receives the same stack.

reward.label: League wins and championship qualification
reward.details: Record wins on the Player Card and bring it to the championship. No fixed nightly cash payout is promised here.

schedule.text: Use the official site’s venue timetable and notices. No future dated starts have been generated from its recurring schedule.

sections.title: Where can I play?
sections.text: The league covers Brevard and Indian River counties. Open the official venue directory for a location near you, then confirm the game and the venue’s entry policy.

sections.title: Is it completely free?
sections.text: There is no tournament entry fee. The rules award extra chips for certain purchases, so review those conditions before choosing a game.

sections.title: When is the next Quads tournament?
sections.text: The organizer announces November 7, 2026 at 13:00 at Melbourne Moose Lodge, with qualification running September 1–October 31. This is a separate qualifying event, not an unrestricted walk-in game. Ask NQV to confirm your eligibility; the ordinary venue games remain listed on its official timetable.

title: Straight Flush: Free Bar Poker in Minnesota
description: Free live Texas Hold’em at participating Minnesota bars, with no purchase required by league rules. Compare selected dated starts, venue age policies and championship prize conditions before attending.

market.label: Minnesota — participating Twin Cities venues
market.note: A local live league; availability depends on the named Minnesota venue, not US-wide online access.

requirements: Players must be 18+ and meet the venue’s admission policy.
Sign the registration sheet at the venue; championship qualification is separate.
entry.costNote: League rules say no purchase is necessary. Food and drink are separate personal expenses.

reward.label: League standings and championship opportunities
reward.details: Championship rewards vary. Noncash grand prizes require age 21; the rules describe a reduced cash alternative for younger eligible winners. No guaranteed cash prize per weekly game is listed here.

schedule.text: Selected starts explicitly listed on the official October 2026 calendar. Check organizer notices before travelling. The Dog House game on October 4 is excluded because a newer notice says it will not run.

sections.title: How do I join a weekly game?
sections.text: Sign in at the venue. The rules allow late arrivals only through the first break and require their chips to be set out and blinded.

sections.title: Where are the games?
sections.text: The organizer lists Scratch Pizzeria, MC’s Pub, Chanhassen Legion, Jersey’s, Muddy Chicken and Mad Jacks among its venues. Use its location links for addresses.

sections.title: What about the October 4 Dog House listing?
sections.text: An organizer notice cancels that game despite its calendar entry. Other venue starts are listed below; confirm any last-minute changes with the host.

sections.title: Can anyone enter the October 17 noon tournament?
sections.text: The calendar lists a separate Tournament of Champions for the July–September session at The Dog House on October 17 at noon. The organizer has announced a qualifier list; do not treat it as an open weekly game. The 15:30 MC’s Pub listing is a separate ordinary game.

reviewNote: The October 4 Dog House calendar entry conflicts with the organizer’s newer cancellation notice; that start is not listed here.

title: All In Atlanta: Free Live Poker in Georgia
description: Free live Hold’em in Atlanta for players aged 21+. Check bonus-chip conditions and venue prizes before attending.

market.label: Georgia — Atlanta venues
market.note: Local venue games, not US-wide online access.

requirements: Age 21+; attend in person.
Use Active Games check-in when opened by the host.
entry.costNote: No purchase required. Optional purchases earn capped bonus chips in the first five rounds; free alternatives are available.

reward.label: Venue prizes and league points
reward.details: Venue prizes vary. Quarterly championships require separate qualification; no fixed cash prize is confirmed.

schedule.text: Weekly games: Monday and Thursday at Wicked Wolf; Wednesday at 5 Paces. All start at 8pm Atlanta time. Confirm operation with the host; dated starts are not published here.

sections.title: Can I play without a purchase?
sections.text: Yes. The starting stack is free; ask the tournament director about free bonus-chip options.
